title: Brendon Burchard's High Performance Planner — My 1 Year Experience
summary: A personal review after one year of using Brendon Burchard's High Performance Planner. Covers what the planner is, why it stands out over other journals, its limitations, and why you should read High Performance Habits first before starting it.
show_notes_text:
### Brendon Burchard's High Performance Planner — My 1 Year Experience

I started to take self-reflection and planning seriously quite late in my life. When I intentionally wanted to get better at both, I was unable to find good resources — I tried a few journals and planners, each with a myriad of problems.

That's when I stumbled upon Brendon Burchard's High-Performance Planner.

In this episode:
- What the planner is and why I find it better than alternatives
- Things it doesn't help with
- Why you're better off starting with Brendon's book *High Performance Habits* first

**Resources:**
- High Performance Planner (2 months): https://amzn.to/3xjo6do
- High Performance Planner (12 months): https://amzn.to/3yk86bb
- High Performance Habits (book): https://amzn.to/3AkbXH8
